URL: https://egspasc.ac.in/public/academics/departments/biotechnology EXTRACTOR: requests+bs4 Home Academics Departments Biotechnology Department of Biotechnology About the Department

Biotechnology is the use of living organisms, biological systems, or their components to develop products and technologies for specific purposes. This multidisciplinary field combines biology, chemistry, and engineering to create useful innovations in areas like medicine, agriculture, and industry, and can include both ancient practices and modern techniques. Since its inception, the Department has contributed a lot in terms of teaching, learning and research

. We have a team of faculties who contributes much to the development of the potentials of students. Department enhances the knowledge base of students and creates research curiosity among students generating highly skilled human resource. The autonomy brings into force industry and research oriented syllabus and hour based curriculum helps the students to excel their knowledge towards innovate, incubate ideas and nurture the needs of society.

Scope of Biotechnology Biotechnology offers wide career opportunities in healthcare, agriculture, environment and industry. It provides skills to develop innovative technologies like vaccines, biofuels, and gene-based solutions. Students can work in R&D labs, pharma companies, biotech industries, and government research institutes. This field supports sustainable agriculture through tissue culture, biofertilizers, and improved crop varieties.

Biotechnology graduates have strong scope for higher studies, research, and global job opportunities. Overview The Faculty of Biotechnology bridges scientific discovery and real-world applications. Our programs equip students with the knowledge, skills, and expertise to solve complex problems and drive innovation across healthcare, agriculture, environment, and industry. Vision Students learn to apply the principles of biology, medicine, and science with

problem-solving and critical thinking to a broad spectrum of problems in biotechnology and medicine. The Department is enriched with quality journals and periodicals. Mission Producing quality technocrats with strong knowledge in Biological Sciences. Strengthening research activities within the department. Encouraging consultancy and extension services involving students and faculty. Preparing students for placements and higher studies; building industry-ready talent. Infrastructure

Infrastructure The labs are well equipped with PCR, Gel Documentation system, Flame Photometers, Horizontal & Vertical Laminar Airflow Chambers, Spectrophotometer, Electrophoresis apparatus, Cooling & Clinical Centrifuges, Incubators, Hot Air Oven, Shaking Incubator, Deep Freezer, UV Transilluminator, and other essential instruments for molecular biology workflows. URL: https://egspasc.ac.in/public/academics/departments/microbiology EXTRACTOR: requests+bs4 Home Academics Departments Microbiology Department of Microbiology About the Department E.G.S Arts & Science College is offered the Microbiology department with a focus on providing career oriented education, including a B.Sc in microbiology that prepares students for advanced studies. Scope of Microbiology

Scope of Microbiology The scope in this field is immense due to the involvement of microbiology in many fields like .There is vast scope in the field of microbiology due to the advancement in the field of science and technology. The study of microbiology contributes greatly to the understanding of life through enhancements and intervention of microorganisms. There is an increase in demand for microbiologists globally. Genetics:

Genetics: Mainly involves engineered microbes to make hormones, vaccine, antibiotics and many other useful products for human being. Agriculture: The influence of microbes on agriculture; the prevention of the diseases that mainly damage the useful crops. Food science: It involves the prevention of spoilage of food and food borne diseases and the uses of microbes to produce cheese, yoghurt, pickles and beer. Immunology: The study of immune system which protect the body from pathogens Medicine:

Medicine: deals with the identification of plans and measures to cure diseases of human and animals which are infectious to them. Industry: it involves use of microbes to produce antibiotics, steroids, alcohol, vitamins and amino acids etc. Agricultural microbiology:

Agricultural microbiology: try to combat plant diseases that attack important food crops, work on methods to increase soil fertility and crop yields etc. Currently there is a great interest in using bacterial or viral insect pathogens as substitute for chemical pesticides. Microbial ecology: biogeochemical cycles – bioremediation to reduce pollutioneffects Food and dairy microbiology:

Food and dairy microbiology: try to prevent microbial spoilage of food and transmission of food borne diseases such as botulism and salmonellosis. Use microorganisms to make foods such as cheese, yogurt, pickles and beers. Industrial microbiology: used to make products such as antibiotics, vaccines, steroids, alcohols and other solvents, vitamins, amino acids and enzymes. Microbial physiology and Biochemistry:

Microbial physiology and Biochemistry: study the synthesis of antibiotics and toxins, microbial energy production, microbial nitrogen fixation, effects of chemical and physical agents on microbial growth and survival etc. Microbial genetics and Molecular biology: nature of genetic information and how it regulated the development and function of cells and organisms. Development of new microbial strains those are more efficient in synthesizing useful products. Genetic engineering:

Genetic engineering: arisen from work of microbial genetics and molecular biology. Engineered microorganisms are used to make hormones, antibiotics, vaccines and other products. New genes can be inserted into plants and animals etc. Overview

Overview The Department of Microbiology at E.G.S Arts & Science College provides a comprehensive understanding of microorganisms and their roles in various sectors. Our curriculum is designed to equip students with theoretical knowledge and practical skills required for a successful career in microbiology. The food and nutrition course can improve the nutritional status of populations

Scope of Nutrition and Dietetics The field of nutrition and dietetics is really growing in India right now! More and more people are becoming aware of how important healthy eating is for their well-being. Commerce - Computer Application is defined as the buying and selling of goods or services, especially on a large scale. Commerce includes all those activities, which directly or indirectly facilitate the distribution aspect of the goods or services included in trade or business. Bachelor of Commerce or B.Com with Computer Application is a graduate program in commerce with a span of three years of study

. This six semester program teaches different aspects of commerce with special consideration to Computer Application. Computer applications are application software which is a set of instructions or code written in a program for executing a task or an operation in a computer. This course helps students to acquire knowledge in commerce subjects along with awareness in computer applications subjects like computer programming, information technology, Business economics, computer accounting etc.

Vision To develop competent commerce graduates with contemporary computer application skills, ethical values and an entrepreneurial mindset to contribute to business and society. Mission Impart strong theoretical foundations in commerce, accountancy and management. Provide practical exposure to computer applications: programming, databases, ERP and MIS. Foster critical thinking, research aptitude, problem-solving and entrepreneurial skills.

Build industry linkages for internships, projects and placements. Instill professional ethics, social responsibility and lifelong learning. URL: https://egspasc.ac.in/public/academics/departments/fashion-technology-and-costume-designing EXTRACTOR: requests+bs4 Home Academics Departments Fashion Technology & Costume Designing About the Department Bachelor of Fashion Technology and Costume Designing

is a dynamic, multidisciplinary program that seamlessly blends artistic creativity with essential technical and business skills, preparing students comprehensively for the demands of the global fashion industry. It offers a complete understanding of the fashion process, starting from the initial design concept all the way to the final garment production.

A significant portion of the curriculum is dedicated to core technical skills like manual and computer-aided pattern making (CAD), mastering the art of drafting basic patterns, and the nuance of fabric draping on forms. The program also integrates modern fashion technology and explores the vital business aspects of the industry, such as merchandising, marketing, trend forecasting, and quality control standards

. Ultimately, the course is structured to develop highly job-ready skills, providing numerous opportunities for internships and real-world exposure to production houses, design firms, and the broader creative arts sector.

Scope Fashion Technology integrates manufacturing processes, utilizing tools like 3D printing and CAD software to produce innovative, sustainable, and mass-market appealing apparel and textiles. Costume Designing is an artistic field involving extensive research to create specific outfits for characters in film, theatre, or television productions, focusing on narrative requirements and historical context rather than general market trends. Career Scope

Career Scope in costume design typically leads to jobs in the entertainment industry, working with directors, stylists, and makeup artists to bring characters to life visually. Vision Provide rigorous standards for design knowledge, illustration skills, industrial and professional behaviour; contribute to a designer society through teaching in classrooms, fashion studios, and software-led design; and foster a collaborative, collegial, and cooperative learning community of diverse students.

Mission Be a core of excellence in fashion designing. Produce creative design projects and valuable critiques. Implement global standards and encourage innovation through quality education. Develop professionals who contribute to society with integrity and commitment. Foster student innovation and hands-on capability building. Programs Offered Program Duration Overview B.Sc. Fashion Technology & Costume Designing 3 Years

3 Years Focus on garment manufacturing technology, textile science, CAD, illustration, surface embellishments, merchandising, and portfolio development; strong industry exposure through events and workshops. Clinical Biochemist Working in hospital or private laboratories to analyze patient samples and aid in disease diagnosis and monitoring. Pharmacologist

Biotechnology Specialist/Engineer Applying knowledge of living organisms to create new products, often in pharmaceutical or manufacturing settings. Forensic Scientist Collecting and analyzing evidence from crime scenes using biochemical techniques for legal proceedings. Science Writer/Consultant

Science Writer/Consultant Applying scientific knowledge to advise organizations or communicate complex research findings to a broader audience. About the Department Physics is the scientific study of matter and energy, investigating how the fundamental constituents of the universe interact and behave. It seeks to understand the physical world from the smallest subatomic particles to the entire universe, focusing on concepts like motion, forces, energy, and space-time. Physics is considered a fundamental science, as its principles are the foundation for many other scientific disciplines and technological advancements. Vision

Vision To impart Physics knowledge to rural and semi-urban students so they become educated individuals equipped for life, capable of contributing to the scientific and technological development of society. Mission To nurture enthusiasm, strong interest, and passion towards learning Physics. To train students in both theoretical and experimental Physics to develop critical thinking, logical reasoning, and application skills.

To improve programme quality through excellence in teaching–learning techniques. To prepare graduates who are skilled to meet the needs and challenges of a dynamic society. To promote current scientific knowledge and achievements through active research involvement. URL: https://egspasc.ac.in/public/academics/departments/visual-communication EXTRACTOR: requests+bs4 Home Academics Departments Visual Communication Department of Visual Communication About the Department

About the Department Visual communication is the practice of using visual elements like images, symbols, typography, and design to convey messages, ideas, and information. It is a powerful and efficient way to communicate, as it can quickly convey complex concepts and evoke emotions, transcending language barriers. The field includes a wide range of media, from traditional methods like drawing and photography to digital tools such as graphic design software, animation, and video.

The department of visual communication was established in 2018 at E.G.S.Pillay College. Since its inception, the department has been dedicated to nurturing creative minds with strong foundations in media, design, photography, and communication. Over the years, it has grown into a vibrant centre for innovation, practical learning, and industry-focused training, empowering students to excel in various creative fields. Scope of Objective Film and television:

Scope of Objective Film and television: Working as a director, animator, editor, cinematographer, or producer in film, documentary, or television production. Digital media and web design: Designing user-friendly interfaces, websites, and engaging content for online platforms and social media. Graphic design: Working as a graphic designer, layout artist, or illustrator for a variety of clients and projects. Multimedia and animation:

Multimedia and animation: Creating 2D and 3D animations and multimedia content for various applications. Programs Offered Program Duration Eligibility B.Sc., Visual Communication 3 Years Higher Secondary Examination (Academic or Vocational) or an equivalent. Vision To emerge as a premier center of excellence in visual communication, fostering creative innovation and professional integrity to shape global leaders in media and design. Mission

Mission To provide industry-oriented training that blends creative expression with technical mastery. To empower students with ethical values and critical thinking for responsible media practices. To cultivate a research-oriented environment that drives innovation in visual storytelling. URL: https://egspasc.ac.in/public/academics/departments/biochemistry EXTRACTOR: requests+bs4 Home Academics Departments Biochemistry Department of Biochemistry About the Department

The Department of Biochemistry was established in 1998 under the Tutelage of Chev.Dr.G.S.pillay Ayya and offered B.Sc., M.Sc., and Ph.D., in Biochemistry; from then it is imparting quality education in the field of life sciences. It has excellent infrastructural facilities to cater to the needs of the students. The department has organized workshops and seminars in the yester years in association with other related departments. It has got many of its alumni well placed in India and Abroad.

Scope of Biochemistry Biochemistry is one of the branches of chemistry which deals with the chemical basis of life in plants and animals. It is used in clinical diagnosis, manufacture of various biological products treatment of diseases, in nutrition, agriculture, etc. It tries to explain life in terms of biochemical reactions, including other sciences as anatomy, medicine, agriculture, pharmacy, etc. Vision To be a centre of excellence that advances understanding of biochemical and molecular

events—forming a keystone of modern biomedical sciences—and enhances the quality of life. Mission Provide broad-based knowledge of biochemistry at molecular and scientific levels. Uphold ethical teaching and a supportive, inclusive learning environment. Promote innovation and novel approaches in PG projects and doctoral research. Offer rigorous experimental exposure through industrial visits and internships. Encourage high-quality student activities with mutual respect and care at work.

. It enables an amiable atmosphere for scientific development and monitors the research activities of the college. URL: https://egspasc.ac.in/about/history EXTRACTOR: requests+bs4 Home About History Edayathangudy G.S. Pillay Arts and Science College (EGSPASC) was established in 1996 in Thethi Village, Nagapattinam, Tamil Nadu, under the stewardship of the G.S. Pillay & Sons Charitable and Educational Trust. Guided by the motto, “To make every man a success and no man a failure,” the college has steadily evolved into a leading autonomous institution affiliated with Bharathidasan University

and accredited with an A Grade by NAAC. Founded in 1996 by the G.S. Pillay & Sons Charitable and Educational Trust to bring quality education to rural Nagapattinam. Adopted the empowering motto: “To make every man a success and no man a failure.” Achieved affiliated status with Bharathidasan University and later attained autonomous accreditation. Earned NAAC 'A' Grade accreditation in recognition of sustained academic quality.

Gradually expanded academic offerings to include multiple UG, PG, M.Phil., and Ph.D. programs across arts, science, commerce, and management disciplines. Transitioned from a modest rural college to a dynamic, student-centric institution fostering research, innovation, and outreach.

PO2

PO4

PO6

PO7 Understand the impact of the professional engineering solutions in societal and environmental contexts, and demonstrate the knowledge of, and need for sustainable development. PO8

PO8 Apply ethical principles and commit to professional ethics and responsibilities and norms of the engineering practice. PO9 Function effectively as an individual, and as a member or leader in diverse teams, and in multidisciplinary settings. PO10

PO10 Communicate effectively on complex engineering activities with the engineering community and with society at large, such as, being able to comprehend and write effective reports and design documentation, make effective presentations, and give and receive clear instructions. PO11 Demonstrate knowledge and understanding of the engineering and management principles and apply these to one’s own work, as a member and leader in a team, to manage projects and in multidisciplinary environments.

PO12 Recognize the need for, and have the preparation and ability to engage in independent and lifelong learning in the broadest context of technological change. URL: https://egspec.org/academics/departments/undergraduate/computer-science-and-engineering EXTRACTOR: requests+bs4 Academics Departments Computer Science and Engineering About

The Department of Computer Science and Engineering was established at Edayathangudy G.S. Pillay Engineering College in the academic year 1995-1996. The department's goal is to meet the demand for Computer Engineers in software companies, banking sectors, and private sectors. The department has been offering the UG program since 1995 and the PG program since 2012. It has a Recognized Research Centre for PhD/M.S. (By Research) and obtained Permanent Affiliation from Anna University in 2014-15
. The department was accredited by NBA in 2016 and achieved NBA-Tier 1 accreditation in 2021.

The department boasts highly qualified and experienced faculty members, and has well-equipped infrastructure including seven laboratories for practical work, an additional lab for hardware and software, and a research lab for research activities. We provide Programming Skill Development Training using tools like E-Box, Skillrack, Terv, Datanerdz, AWS, and Android Development Kit
. The department has also received funding from TNSCST under Young Scientist Research Fellowship and Computer Skills for School Students.

The department has established the Computer Engineers Association (CEA) to promote student talent and development. We organize international and national conferences through the association. Notably, we conducted the ACES-ACM-IIT Delhi India’s Biggest Networking Championship Zonal Level Workshop cum Competition, with winners participating in the final competition in Delhi

. The department offers various industry-oriented training courses, value-added courses, and competitive exam training (GATE, GRE, TOEFL, etc.). We also run social programs like Computer Literacy Awareness Programs for government employees, the public, and school students. Our students have excelled in co-curricular and extra-curricular activities, including participation in the Guinness Record for the Biggest Software Development Project at Kaashiv Infotech, Chennai.

Vision To produce globally competent computer professionals capable of adapting to the ever-changing technological trends of industry and society. Mission 1. To build core competencies desirable for computer professionals, including design, development, testing, and maintenance of software systems for real-world projects. 2. To train students in emerging technologies to make them preferable to employers.

3. To provide state-of-the-art learning facilities for effective implementation of learner-centric teaching and learning processes, fostering professional skills, self-learning, and lifelong learning capabilities. URL: https://egspec.org/academics/departments/undergraduate/artificial-intelligence-and-data-science/program-outcomes EXTRACTOR: requests+bs4 Academics Departments Artificial Intelligence and Data Science Program Outcomes Program Outcomes (POs) ## PO1 Engineering knowledge: Apply the knowledge of mathematics, science, engineering fundamentals, and an engineering specialization to the solution of complex engineering problems. PO2

PO2 Problem analysis: Identify, formulate, review research literature, and analyze complex engineering problems reaching substantiated conclusions using first principles of mathematics, natural sciences, and engineering sciences. PO3

PO3 Design/development of solutions: Design solutions for complex engineering problems and design system components or processes that meet the specified needs with appropriate consideration for the public health and safety, and the cultural, societal, and environmental considerations. PO4

PO4 Conduct investigations of complex problems: Use research-based knowledge and research methods including design of experiments, analysis and interpretation of data, and synthesis of the information to provide valid conclusions. PO5 Modern tool usage: Create, select, and apply appropriate techniques, resources, and modern engineering and IT tools including prediction and modeling to complex engineering activities with an understanding of the limitations. PO6

PO6 The engineer and society: Apply reasoning informed by the contextual knowledge to assess societal, health, safety, legal and cultural issues and the consequent responsibilities relevant to the professional engineering practice. PO7 Environment and sustainability: Understand the impact of the professional engineering solutions in societal and environmental contexts, and demonstrate the knowledge of, and need for sustainable development. PO8

PO8 Ethics: Apply ethical principles and commit to professional ethics and responsibilities and norms of the engineering practice. PO9 Individual and team work: Function effectively as an individual, and as a member or leader in diverse teams, and in multidisciplinary settings. PO10

PO10 Communication: Communicate effectively on complex engineering activities with the engineering community and with society at large, such as, being able to comprehend and write effective reports and design documentation, make effective presentations, and give and receive clear instructions. PO11

PO11 Project management and finance: Demonstrate knowledge and understanding of the engineering and management principles and apply these to one’s own work, as a member and leader in a team, to manage projects and in multidisciplinary environments. PO12 Life-long learning: Recognize the need for, and have the preparation and ability to engage in independent and life-long learning in the broadest context of technological change. The program was initiated in 2001 with approval from Bharathidasan University, Tiruchirappalli.

In 2003, the course received recognition and approval from Anna University, Chennai. Since 2011, the department has maintained an annual intake of 60 students. The institution currently enjoys autonomous status, enabling the department to regularly update the curriculum in alignment with the evolving needs of academia and industry, ensuring students are industry-ready upon graduation. Vision of the Department To produce software professionals with Academic Excellence in Computer Applications.

Mission of the Department Mission Statements M1 To make software professionals and entrepreneurs by imparting quality teaching and learning practice. M2 To promote inter-disciplinary research among the faculty and the students to create state of art research facilities. M3 To prepare the students to be professionally competent to face the challenges in the industry. M4 To promote quality and ethics among the students. URL: https://egspec.org/academics/departments/undergraduate/electronics-and-communication-engineering EXTRACTOR: requests+bs4 Academics Departments Electronics And Communication Engineering About

Electronics And Communication Engineering About The Department of Electronics and Communication Engineering was established in 2004 with an initial intake of 30 students. This intake was increased to 60 in 2006, and further to 120 in 2013, the same year the postgraduate program in Communication Systems, with an intake of 18 students, was launched. In 2015, the department was recognized as a Research Center by Anna University, Chennai, and also received permanent affiliation.

Today, the department is rated as one of the leading departments among various colleges under the university, boasting a NAAC A grade and Autonomous status. Our curriculum is regularly updated to meet the evolving needs of the industry and research community. The laboratories are equipped with the latest technology to keep pace with curriculum changes. In addition to regular labs, we are developing specialized labs in image processing, RF system design, and more
. Our alumni are employed in prestigious industries both in India and abroad.

Our faculty members specialize in areas such as Analog Electronics, Advanced Digital System Design, Digital Signal and Image Processing, Medical Electronics, Embedded Systems, Nanotechnology, VLSI Technology, Wired and Wireless Networking, Analog and Digital Communication, Fuzzy Control and Neural Networks, and software tools like Matlab, LabVIEW, Mentor Graphics, NS2, Keil, SPICE, Circuit Maker, and various open-source software
. The department is supported by a dedicated team of qualified faculty members with rich industrial, research, and teaching experience.

Vision To achieve excellence in Electronics and Communication Engineering by imparting contemporary knowledge and skills to students, serving as a valuable resource center for the industry and society. Mission 1. To provide quality education and training in the field of electronics. 2. To maintain state-of-the-art learning facilities, enhance the competence of faculty, and evolve as a center of excellence through research and development.

3. To enable students to acquire effective communication skills, a lifelong learning attitude, teamwork capabilities, and the aspiration for higher education. 4. To bridge the gap between industry and academia by expanding collaborations and partnerships through MOUs, projects, and consultancy services, thus fulfilling societal needs. PO2

PO2 Problem analysis: Identify, formulate, research literature, and analyze complex engineering problems reaching substantiated conclusions using first principles of mathematics, natural sciences, and engineering sciences. PO3

PO3 Design/development of solutions: Design solutions for complex engineering problems and design system components or processes that meet the specified needs with appropriate consideration for public health and safety, and cultural, societal, and environmental considerations. PO4

PO4 Conduct investigations of complex problems: Use research-based knowledge and research methods including design of experiments, analysis and interpretation of data, and synthesis of the information to provide valid conclusions. PO5 Modern tool usage: Create, select, and apply appropriate techniques, resources, and modern engineering and IT tools, including prediction and modeling to complex engineering activities, with an understanding of the limitations. PO6

PO6 The engineer and society: Apply reasoning informed by the contextual knowledge to assess societal, health, safety, legal, and cultural issues and the consequent responsibilities relevant to the professional engineering practice. PO7 Environment and sustainability: Understand the impact of the professional engineering solutions in societal and environmental contexts, and demonstrate the knowledge of, and need for sustainable development. PO8

PO10 Communication: Communicate effectively on complex engineering activities with the engineering community and with society at large, such as being able to comprehend and write effective reports and design documentation, make effective presentations, and give and receive clear instructions. PO11

PO11 Project management and finance: Demonstrate knowledge and understanding of the engineering and management principles and apply these to one’s own work, as a member and leader in a team, to manage projects and in multidisciplinary environments. PO12 Life-long learning: Recognize the need for, and have the preparation and ability to engage in independent and life-long learning in the broadest context of technological change. URL: https://egspec.org/academics/departments/undergraduate/cyber-security/program-outcomes EXTRACTOR: requests+bs4 Academics Departments Cyber Security Program Outcomes Program Outcomes (POs) PO # Program Outcomes Description PO1 Engineering Knowledge: Apply the knowledge of mathematics, science, engineering fundamentals, and specialized cyber defense techniques to the solution of complex computing and cybersecurity problems. PO2 Problem Analysis:

PO2 Problem Analysis: Identify, formulate, review research literature, and analyze complex cybersecurity challenges reaching substantiated conclusions using first principles of computer science, cryptography, and network security. PO3 Design/Development of Solutions: Design robust security architectures, defense systems, and secure software components that meet specified needs with appropriate consideration for public safety, confidentiality, and data privacy regulations. PO4

PO4 Conduct Investigations of Complex Problems: Use research-based knowledge and security analysis methods including vulnerability assessments, digital forensics, log forensics, and penetration testing to provide valid security findings. PO5 Modern Tool Usage: Create, select, and apply appropriate cybersecurity and forensic tools (such as SIEM, Wireshark, Metasploit, Nessus, Autopsy, and IDS/IPS) to secure modern computing environments with an understanding of limitations. PO6

PO6 The Engineer and Society: Apply contextual knowledge to assess cyber law, digital compliance, information privacy, and societal responsibilities relevant to the professional cybersecurity practice. PO7 Environment and Sustainability: Understand the impact of secure and sustainable digital infrastructure solutions in societal and environmental contexts, promoting sustainable IT operations. PO8 Ethics:

PO8 Ethics: Apply rigorous ethical principles, adhere to responsible vulnerability disclosure policies, and commit to professional ethics and legal standards in cybersecurity. PO9 Individual and Team Work: Function effectively as an individual, and as a member or leader in diverse incident response teams and multidisciplinary security settings. PO10 Communication:

PO10 Communication: Communicate effectively on complex security architectures, threat reports, and audit findings with both technical teams and organizational executives. PO11 Project Management and Finance: Demonstrate knowledge and understanding of cybersecurity management principles, risk governance, and apply these to manage security projects effectively. PO12 Life-long Learning:

PO12 Life-long Learning: Recognize the ongoing evolution of cyber threat landscapes and possess the preparation and ability to engage in independent lifelong learning and continuous security certification. Electrical And Electronics Engineering About The department of Electrical and Electronics Engineering was started in the year 2000 with an intake of 40 students in the B.E - EEE programme. The intake was revised to 60 in the year 2001. The PG programme M.E - Power Electronics and Drives was added in the year 2013. The department has well-established laboratories and well-experienced teaching faculty.

The department has got permanent affiliation from Anna University - Chennai in the year 2014 and has got Research Center recognition for doing Ph.D. and M.S (By research) programmes. The B.E (EEE) programme was accredited by NBA in the year 2016. The department aims at producing globally competent electrical and electronics engineers. It conducts technical and non-technical events every year to improve the interpersonal skills of the students. Vision

Vision The department is envisioned to produce globally competent electrical and electronics engineers. Mission 1. To impart the contemporary knowledge in the field of electrical and electronics engineering with high human values. 2. To offer state-of-the-art facilities for conducive learning and conducting research. 3. To train the students for a professional career and higher education by imparting self-learning and interpersonal skills. Other Links Magazine 2025 Newsletter 2025

URL: https://egspec.org/iqac/works-plan-and-implementation EXTRACTOR: requests+bs4 IQAC Works and Implementation EGSPEC IQAC Works & Implementation EGSPEC IQAC outlines its comprehensive plan for improving quality teaching, student development, faculty growth, and internal quality audits. 1. Quality Teaching & Learning Process Ensuring effective teaching and learning at both course and domain levels through classroom sessions, laboratory activities, and various related programs.

2. Documentation Process Maintaining a single file that covers NBA, NAAC, and ISO requirements, as well as managing online documents and databases at both institutional and departmental levels, with centralized access. 3. Academic Audits Conducting four internal audits (two per post every semester) and one external audit per year for each post during the even semester. Action taken reports will be generated for all institutional committees, offices, and departments (UG & PG).

4. Students Development Programs & Activities Facilitating skill-based training programs for students, with a requirement that each student participate in at least one event per semester to foster overall development. 5. Faculty Development Activities Planning faculty development initiatives under the Margha Dharshan scheme, with a requirement for all faculty members to participate in at least one event per year to enhance their skills and knowledge. 6. IQAC Sponsored Programs

6. IQAC Sponsored Programs Organizing programs such as Outcome-Based Education (OBE), auditing, and action-based programs. A minimum of four or five such programs will be conducted annually to ensure consistent quality improvement. 7. AQAR Fill-up & Submission The Annual Quality Assurance Report (AQAR) will be filled out and submitted online by December 31st each year, with the necessary evidence included for compliance and transparency.

URL: https://egspec.org/academics/departments/undergraduate/electronics-and-communication-engineering/knowledge-and-attitude-profile EXTRACTOR: requests+bs4 Academics Departments Electronics And Communication Engineering Knowledge and Attitude Profile Knowledge and Attitude Profile (WK) ## WK1 A systematic, theory-based understanding of the natural sciences applicable to the discipline and awareness of relevant social sciences. WK2

WK2 Conceptually-based mathematics, numerical analysis, data analysis, statistics and formal aspects of computer and information science to support detailed analysis and modelling applicable to the discipline. WK3 A systematic, theory-based formulation of engineering fundamentals required in the engineering discipline. WK4

WK4 Engineering specialist knowledge that provides theoretical frameworks and bodies of knowledge for the accepted practice areas in the engineering discipline; much is at the forefront of the discipline. WK5 Knowledge, including efficient resource use, environmental impacts, whole-life cost, reuse of resources, net zero carbon, and similar concepts, that supports engineering design and operations in a practice area. WK6

WK6 Knowledge of engineering practice (technology) in the practice areas in the engineering discipline. WK7 Knowledge of the role of engineering in society and identified issues in engineering practice in the discipline, such as the professional responsibility of an engineer to public safety and sustainable development. WK8

WK8 Engagement with selected knowledge in the current research literature of the discipline, awareness of the power of critical thinking and creative approaches to evaluate emerging issues. WK9 Ethics, inclusive behavior and conduct. Knowledge of professional ethics, responsibilities, and norms of engineering practice. Awareness of the need for diversity by reason of ethnicity, gender, age, physical ability etc. with mutual understanding and respect, and of inclusive attitudes.

URL: https://egspec.org/academics/departments/postgraduate/master-of-computer-applications/program-outcomes EXTRACTOR: requests+bs4 Academics Departments Master of Computer Applications Program Outcomes Program Outcomes (POs) ## PO1 Foundation Knowledge: Apply knowledge of mathematics, programming logic and coding fundamentals for solution architecture and problem solving. PO2

PO2 Problem Analysis: Identify, review, formulate and analyse problems for primarily focusing on customer requirements using critical thinking frameworks. PO3 Development of Solutions: Design, develop and investigate problems with an innovative approach for solutions incorporating ESG/SDG goals. PO4 Modern Tool Usage: Select, adapt and apply modern computational tools such as development of algorithms with an understanding of the limitations including human biases. PO5

PO5 Individual and Teamwork: Function and communicate effectively as an individual or a team leader in diverse and multidisciplinary groups. Use methodologies such as agile. PO6 Project Management and Finance: Use the principles of project management such as scheduling, work breakdown structure and be conversant with the principles of Finance for profitable project management. PO7

PO7 Ethics: Commit to professional ethics in managing software projects with financial aspects. Learn to use new technologies for cyber security and insulate customers from malware. PO8 Life-long learning: Change management skills and the ability to learn, keep up with contemporary technologies and ways of working. The Department of Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning (AI & ML) at E.G.S. Pillay Engineering College is established to pioneer next-generation cognitive computing, deep learning algorithms, and intelligent autonomous systems. As artificial intelligence transforms every sector of industry and society, our B.Tech

. AI & ML programme equips engineers with deep theoretical foundations, algorithmic thinking, and hands-on proficiency in machine learning, deep neural networks, natural language processing, computer vision, reinforcement learning, robotics, and generative AI

. Supported by cutting-edge GPU-accelerated computing infrastructure and a vibrant research culture, students build scalable, ethical, and transformative AI solutions that address pressing industry challenges and shape the future of intelligent technologies.

Vision To be an internationally acclaimed center of excellence in Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning education, state-of-the-art research, and ethical innovation, nurturing transformative engineers who lead the intelligent technology era. Mission To deliver a comprehensive, industry-aligned curriculum combining core computing principles with advanced AI and Machine Learning methodologies.

To promote interdisciplinary research and innovation in deep learning, computer vision, generative AI, and autonomous intelligent systems. To establish strong industry partnerships and global collaborative networks providing experiential learning and cutting-edge project opportunities. URL: https://egspec.org/academics/departments/undergraduate/electrical-and-electronics-engineering/program-outcomes EXTRACTOR: requests+bs4 Academics Departments Electrical and Electronics Engineering Program Outcomes Program Outcomes (POs) ## PO1: Engineering Knowledge Apply knowledge of mathematics, natural science, computing, engineering fundamentals and an engineering specialization as specified in WK1 to WK4 respectively to develop to the solution of complex engineering problems.

PO2: Problem Analysis Identify, formulate, review research literature and analyze complex engineering problems reaching substantiated conclusions with consideration for sustainable development. PO3: Design/Development of Solutions Design creative solutions for complex engineering problems and design/develop systems/components/processes to meet identified needs with consideration for the public health and safety, whole-life cost, net zero carbon, culture, society and environment as required.

PO4: Conduct Investigations of Complex Problems Conduct investigations of complex engineering problems using research-based knowledge including design of experiments, modelling, analysis & interpretation of data to provide valid conclusions. PO5: Engineering Tool Usage Create, select and apply appropriate techniques, resources and modern engineering & IT tools, including prediction and modelling recognizing their limitations to solve complex engineering problems. PO6: The Engineer and The World

PO6: The Engineer and The World Analyze and evaluate societal and environmental aspects while solving complex engineering problems for its impact on sustainability with reference to economy, health, safety, legal framework, culture and environment. PO7: Ethics Apply ethical principles and commit to professional ethics, human values, diversity and inclusion; adhere to national & international laws. PO8: Individual and Collaborative Team work

PO8: Individual and Collaborative Team work Function effectively as an individual, and as a member or leader in diverse/multi-disciplinary teams. PO9: Communication Communicate effectively and inclusively within the engineering community and society at large, such as being able to comprehend and write effective reports and design documentation, make effective presentations considering cultural, language, and learning differences PO10: Project Management and Finance

PO10: Project Management and Finance Apply knowledge and understanding of engineering management principles and economic decision-making and apply these to one’s own work, as a member and leader in a team, and to manage projects and in multidisciplinary environments. PO11: Life-Long Learning

PO11: Life-Long Learning Recognize the need for, and have the preparation and ability for i) independent and life-long learning ii) adaptability to new and emerging technologies and iii) critical thinking in the broadest context of technological change. URL: https://egspec.org/iqac/iqac-function EXTRACTOR: requests+bs4 IQAC IQAC - Functions Promote Quality Culture in EGSPEC through Quality Enhancing & Sustaining Initiatives EGSPEC IQAC (EGSPEC Internal Quality Cell - EIQC) is committed to promoting and sustaining quality education through strategic initiatives with both internal and external support. Greetings from EGSPEC IQAC!

Greetings from EGSPEC IQAC! We express our gratitude to the management for establishing the IQAC, which plays a key role in implementing and ensuring qualitative education in our institution. The IQAC team is instrumental in carrying out the following strategic functions: 1. Quality Benchmarks Setting Establishing academic quality benchmarks and continuously monitoring and following up on their implementation to ensure excellence in teaching and learning.

2. Parameter Setting for Academic & Administration Goals Setting clear parameters for both academic and administrative goals, ensuring that they align with the institution's long-term objectives. 3. Learn-Centric Environment Creating and maintaining a learning-centric environment that encourages student engagement, participation, and the development of critical thinking and problem-solving skills. 4. Faculty Development

4. Faculty Development Planning and organizing faculty development programs aimed at enhancing the skills and knowledge of teaching staff, supporting them in their professional growth. 5. Feedback Analysis and Follow-up Analyzing feedback from various stakeholders, including students, faculty, and external partners, and taking actionable steps to address any concerns or improvements. 6. Workshops for Quality Improvement

6. Workshops for Quality Improvement Conducting inter-intra workshops aimed at improving the quality of education, faculty development, and effective documentation practices. 7. Acting as Nodal Agency for Quality Initiatives Serving as the primary agency responsible for coordinating all quality-related activities within the institution, ensuring that all departments adhere to established standards. 8. Institutional Database Maintenance

8. Institutional Database Maintenance Maintaining an institutional database to facilitate effective sharing of information, promoting transparency and enhancing overall quality across departments. 9. Academic & Administrative Audits Conducting regular audits of both academic and administrative processes to identify areas for improvement and ensure alignment with institutional goals. 10. AQAR Preparation and Submission

10. AQAR Preparation and Submission Preparing the Annual Quality Assurance Report (AQAR) in accordance with NAAC guidelines and submitting it annually by December 31st, ensuring compliance and transparency in quality management. 11. Implementation of Projects Implementing effective academic and curricular strategies in areas such as CoE, R&D, and other projects, ensuring their successful execution across all departments.

Faculty members are actively engaged in research and have published papers in reputed journals and conferences
. The department has also organized four International Conferences and two Faculty Development Programs.

Vision To foster academic excellence in Mechanical Engineering Education and Research and turn out students into competent professionals to serve the society. Mission To produce successful mechanical engineers through innovative teaching and learning processes and by enhancing the knowledge and skills of faculty members and supporting staff through various training programmes.

To establish state-of-the-art laboratories and centers of excellence to promote good quality education, research, and consultancy for industrial and societal needs. To prepare the students for higher education and successful engineering careers by inculcating leadership and entrepreneurial qualities, teamwork capability, interpersonal skills, lifelong learning, moral, and ethical values. URL: https://egspec.org/blogs/industry-designed-ai-engineering-deep-skilling-program EXTRACTOR: requests+bs4 Share: # Industry-Designed Engineering Program on AI Engineering Deep-Skilling at EGS Pillay Engineering College EGS Pillay Engineering College continues to strengthen industry-oriented education with an Industry-Designed Engineering Program on AI Engineering Deep-Skilling

. The program is designed to help students gain practical knowledge and skills aligned with the evolving needs of the engineering and technology industries. Bridging Academic Learning with Industry Requirements As technology continues to transform industries worldwide, engineering graduates need more than theoretical knowledge. They require exposure to real-world technologies, industry practices, problem-solving approaches, and emerging fields such as Artificial Intelligence.

The AI Engineering Deep-Skilling initiative focuses on aligning student learning with real-world engineering requirements and preparing students for technology-driven careers. Learning Aligned with Leading Global Organizations The program highlights industry exposure associated with leading engineering and technology organizations. The initiative reflects the skills and engineering practices followed across modern global industries.

Organizations highlighted as part of the industry-focused ecosystem include: Whirlpool Infosys HCLTech Nokia Tata Consultancy Services (TCS) Baker Hughes GlobalLogic Renault Nissan Technology & Business Centre India Siemens Healthineers Schneider Electric Bosch Nagarro Johnson Controls Wipro KPIT Tata Technologies Samsung Research L&T Technology Services Continental Why AI Engineering Deep-Skilling Matters

Why AI Engineering Deep-Skilling Matters Artificial Intelligence is increasingly becoming an important part of engineering, manufacturing, software development, automation, healthcare technology, automotive systems, and several other industries. Developing strong AI-related skills can help engineering students understand emerging technologies and become better prepared for future career opportunities.

Through industry-aligned learning, students can strengthen their technical capabilities, practical understanding, analytical thinking, and readiness to work in modern engineering environments. Academic Excellence and Recognition EGS Pillay Engineering College is an autonomous institution affiliated with Anna University. The institution highlights recognitions and accreditations including NBA Tier I Accreditation for eligible programs , NAAC Grade A++
, NAAC Grade A++ , and other quality and institutional recognitions showcased by the college. Preparing Future-Ready Engineers

Preparing Future-Ready Engineers The Industry-Designed Engineering Program on AI Engineering Deep-Skilling reflects EGS Pillay Engineering College's focus on connecting academic education with industry expectations. By providing students with opportunities to develop relevant and practical skills, the institution aims to prepare graduates to confidently meet the challenges of today's rapidly changing technology landscape.

Build your engineering future with industry-aligned learning, advanced technology skills, and real-world exposure at EGS Pillay Engineering College. For more information about admissions and programs, visit or contact EGS Pillay Engineering College, Nagapattinam . Related Tags: #Education

The Institution of Electronics and Telecommunication Engineers (IETE) is India’s leading recognised professional society devoted to the advancement of Science and Technology of Electronics, Telecommunication & IT. Founded in 1953. The IETE is the National Apex Professional body of Electronics and Telecommunication, Computer and IT Professionals. It serves more than 60,000 members through various 65 Centres, spread all over India and abroad

. The Institution provides leadership in Scientific and Technical areas of direct importance to the national development and economy. Government of India has recognised IETE as a Scientific and Industrial Research Organization (SIRO) and also notified as an educational Institution of national eminence. The objectives of IETE focus on advancing electro-technology

. The IETE conducts and sponsors technical meetings, conferences, symposia, and exhibitions all over India, publishes technical journals and provides continuing education as well as career advancement opportunities to its members.

VISION Reaching the un-reached and empowering the youth through Technical Education and Skill Development. MISSION Advancement of Electronics, Telecommunication, Information Technology & other related disciplines to contribute in Nation’s Human Resource & Infrastructure Development through our Engineers. PO2

PO2 Problem analysis: Identify, formulate, review research literature, and analyze complex engineering problems using first principles of mathematics, natural sciences, and engineering sciences to reach substantiated conclusions. PO3 Design/development of solutions: Design solutions for complex engineering problems and system components or processes that meet specified needs while considering public health, safety, and cultural, societal, and environmental impacts. PO4

PO4 Conduct investigations of complex problems: Utilize research-based knowledge and methodologies, including experiment design, data analysis, and information synthesis, to draw valid conclusions. PO5 Modern tool usage: Create, select, and apply appropriate techniques, resources, and modern engineering and IT tools, including prediction and modeling, to complex engineering activities, with an understanding of their limitations. PO6

PO6 The engineer and society: Apply contextual knowledge to assess societal, health, safety, legal, and cultural issues and responsibilities relevant to professional engineering practice. PO7 Environment and sustainability: Understand the impact of professional engineering solutions in societal and environmental contexts and demonstrate knowledge of the need for sustainable development. PO8

PO8 Ethics: Apply ethical principles and commit to professional ethics and responsibilities and norms of engineering practice. PO9 Individual and team work: Function effectively as an individual and as a member or leader in diverse teams and multidisciplinary settings. PO10

PO10 Communication: Communicate effectively on complex engineering activities with the engineering community and society at large, including writing effective reports and design documentation, making effective presentations, and giving and receiving clear instructions. PO11

PO11 Project management and finance: Demonstrate knowledge and understanding of engineering and management principles and apply these to one's own work, as a member and leader in a team, to manage projects and multidisciplinary environments. PO12 Life-long learning: Recognize the need for, and have the preparation and ability to engage in independent and life-long learning amidst technological changes. URL: https://egspec.org/academics/departments/undergraduate/electronics-and-communication-engineering/department-highlights EXTRACTOR: requests+bs4 Academics Departments Electronics And Communication Engineering Department Highlights Year of Establishment 2004 (ECE) Intake at Establishment 30 Intake Increased 60 in 2005 & 120 in 2013 M.E Established 2013 (Communication Systems) M.E Intake 18 Research Centre Recognition 2015 (Research Center under Anna University, Chennai) NBA Accreditation

NBA Accreditation 2019 (3 years - Tier 2) NIRF Ranking 2018 (Below 200) & 2022 (251-300 range) 2022 (3 years - Tier 1) NAAC Accreditation 2016 (A Grade - Cycle 1) & 2023 (A++ Grade - Cycle 2) Department Overview The courses offered are updated regularly to keep pace with the growing demands of the industry and the research community. The laboratories consist of all the latest equipment to meet the dynamic changes in the curriculum. Apart from the regular labs, the department is setting up labs

in image processing, RF system design, Computer vision with the MATLAB campus wide license. The passed-out students are working in various reputed industries in India and many foreign countries. The Department faculty members are specialized in Analog Electronics, Advanced Digital System Design, Digital Signal and Image Processing, Medical Electronics, Embedded system, Nano technology, VLSI technology, Wired and wireless Networking, Analog and Digital

Communication, Fuzzy control and Neural Networks, Software tools like CADENCE, MATLAB, LabVIEW, Mentor Graphics, NS2, Keil, SPICE, Circuit maker, Open source software, etc., The department has a team of committed faculty members who are not only well qualified but are also backed by rich industrial / research / teaching experience. For students we follow Outcome based education as per the NBA norms. The teaching and

learning process are in such a way to follow OBE. The value added courses, workshop, seminars, Conference and symposium are regularly conducted for students to attain all the program outcomes. For faculty members and non teaching faculty members special training for skill up gradation program like NPTEL, other MOOC courses were encouraged to complete in every semester. Also, the FDP, workshop or seminar were encouraged to attend. We are also encourage our staff

member to do research work by publishing high impact factor journals and conference papers, more no. of funded projects and patents. The Department of Civil Engineering was established in the year 2011 with an intake of 60 students. The intake was increased to 120 students in 2013. The department has well-qualified and experienced teaching faculties and technical staff with state-of-the-art laboratories to meet the quality education required for present challenging societal and industrial needs

. The department is involved in Research & Consultancy activities in the areas of Structural Engineering, Environmental Engineering, Geotechnical Engineering, Concrete & Highway Engineering, and Surveying with many national and international publications. The department is actively involved in co-curricular and extra-curricular activities with the association of professional bodies.

Vision To evolve as a Centre of excellence by imparting quality technical education and promote research to meet the emerging challenges in the field of Civil Engineering. Mission Civil Engineering department is committed to: M1: Provide quality education through innovative teaching and learning practices M2: Encourage faculty and students to pursue higher education and carry out socially relevant innovative research thereby establishing centers of excellence in emerging areas of research

M3: Offer consultancy services using state-of-the-art facilities fulfilling the needs of the industry and society. M4: Enable our students and faculty to play leadership roles in a sustainable manner by adopting professional ethics, entrepreneurship activities, interpersonal skills, and lifelong learning attitude. URL: https://egspec.org/academics/departments/undergraduate/artificial-intelligence-and-data-science EXTRACTOR: requests+bs4 Academics Departments Artificial Intelligence and Data Science About

The Artificial Intelligence & Data Science (AI & DS) Department was established in 2022 with an initial intake of 60 students. Currently, the department offers a B.Tech program with an intake of 120 students. The primary objective of this program is to equip students with the knowledge and skills needed to become industry-ready professionals

. Graduates will be prepared for careers as data analysts and data scientists, capable of addressing significant challenges in machine learning, statistics, information discovery, and data visualization. They may find career opportunities in diverse fields such as healthcare, business, e-commerce, social networking, climatology, biotechnology, genetics, and more.
Artificial Intelligence and Data Science encompass the core principles of data science, including the ethical acquisition, engineering, analysis, and visualization of data

. This course aims to teach foundational technologies such as artificial intelligence, data mining, cloud architecture, as well as advanced topics like machine learning, robotics, generative AI, Power BI, big data analytics, and a comprehensive understanding of data science processes, including data wrangling, exploration, visualization, and hypothesis building. Through this course, students will acquire cross-disciplinary skills integrating elements from mathematics, engineering, and technology
. Enrolling in the AI&DS course not only enhances career prospects and creates global job opportunities but also offers extensive research opportunities to address societal and industrial challenges.

Vision The Department of Artificial Intelligence & Data Science will excel and lead in education, research and innovation; contributing to the advancement of design, development and management of data, algorithms to provide meaningfulness in the decision-making process further the emergence of quality artificial intelligence-based solutions to enhance the quality of life for humanity in a sustainable way. Mission

Mission M1: To create an outstanding learning experience through rigorous curriculum of theory and practice that develops students’ technical and professional skills to succeed in a wide range of careers. M2: To continually advance research through a culture of discovery, creativity, and innovation to benefit humankind. M3: To serve as highly capable resources to society and the profession through professional organizations, consultancy, and continuing education. Department Quick Links

URL: https://egspec.org/skill-development-center/pradhan-mantri-kaushal-vikas-yojana EXTRACTOR: requests+bs4 Skill Development Centre Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana (PMKVY) Coordinator/Facilitator : Dr. M. Chinnadurai, Professor & Head/CSE Scheme Details About PMKVY

Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana (PMKVY) is the flagship scheme of the Ministry of Skill Development & Entrepreneurship (MSDE). The objective of this Skill Certification Scheme is to enable a large number of Indian youth to take up industry-relevant skill training that will help them in securing a better livelihood. Individuals with prior learning experience or skills will also be assessed and certified under Recognition of Prior Learning (RPL)
. Under this Scheme, Training and Assessment fees are completely paid by the Government.
Components of the Scheme Short Term Training

The Short Term Training imparted at PMKVY Training Centres (TCs) is expected to benefit candidates of Indian nationality who are either school/college dropouts or unemployed. Apart from providing training according to the National Skills Qualification Framework (NSQF), TCs shall also impart training in Soft Skills, Entrepreneurship, Financial and Digital Literacy. Duration of the training varies per job role, ranging between 150 and 300 hours

. Upon successful completion of their assessment, candidates shall be provided placement assistance by Training Partners (TPs). Under PMKVY, the entire training and assessment fees are paid by the Government. Payouts shall be provided to the TPs in alignment with the Common Norms. Trainings imparted under the Short Term Training component of the Scheme shall be NSQF Level 5 and below.
Recognition of Prior Learning

Individuals with prior learning experience or skills shall be assessed and certified under the Recognition of Prior Learning (RPL) component of the Scheme. RPL aims to align the competencies of the unregulated workforce of the country to the NSQF

. Project Implementing Agencies (PIAs), such as Sector Skill Councils (SSCs) or any other agencies designated by MSDE/NSDC, shall be incentivized to implement RPL projects in any of the three Project Types (RPL Camps, RPL at Employers Premises and RPL centres). To address knowledge gaps, PIAs may offer Bridge Courses to RPL candidates.
Special Projects

The Special Projects component of PMKVY envisages the creation of a platform that will facilitate trainings in special areas and/or premises of Government bodies, Corporates or Industry bodies, and trainings in special job roles not defined under the available Qualification Packs (QPs)/National Occupational Standards (NOSs). Special Projects are projects that require some deviation from the terms and conditions of Short Term Training under PMKVY for any stakeholder

. A proposing stakeholder can be either Government Institutions of Central and State Government(s)/Autonomous Body/Statutory Body or any other equivalent body or corporates who desire to provide training to candidates.
Kaushal and Rozgar Mela

Social and community mobilisation is extremely critical for the success of PMKVY. Active participation of the community ensures transparency and accountability, and helps in leveraging the cumulative knowledge of the community for better functioning. In line with this, PMKVY assigns special importance to the involvement of the target beneficiaries through a defined mobilisation process
. TPs shall conduct Kaushal and Rozgar Melas every six months with press/media coverage; they are also required to participate actively in National Career Service Melas and on-ground activities.

Placement Guidelines PMKVY envisages to link the aptitude, aspiration, and knowledge of the skilled workforce it creates with employment opportunities and demands in the market. Every effort thereby needs to be made by the PMKVY TCs to provide placement opportunities to candidates, trained and certified under the Scheme. TPs shall also provide support to entrepreneurship development. Monitoring Guidelines

Monitoring Guidelines To ensure that high standards of quality are maintained by PMKVY TCs, NSDC and empaneled Inspection Agencies shall use various methodologies, such as self-audit reporting, call validations, surprise visits, and monitoring through the Skills Development Management System (SDMS). These methodologies shall be enhanced with the engagement of latest technologies. The scheme will be implemented through the National Skill Development Corporation (NSDC).

ECE Electronics and Communication Engineering The Department of Electronics and Communication Engineering, established in 2011, has quickly become a leader in its field, with a mission to produce outstanding graduates for the electronics and communication industry. Initially starting with an intake of 60 students, the department has built a reputation for its innovative curriculum and projects, ensuring that students stay abreast of the latest advancements in the electronics sector.

The department boasts exceptional infrastructure, including diverse computing platforms, tailored to meet the ever-evolving needs of the electronics industry. Its impact is evident through the high demand for its graduates by employers worldwide.

From its inception, the department has been supported by highly qualified faculty members specializing in applied electronics, electronics and control, and other areas. These faculty members are dedicated to creating a Centre of Excellence in technical education, aiming to develop technocrats with advanced skills and a strong sense of social responsibility.

With a vision to cultivate competent and disciplined electronics and communication engineers, the department continues to set a high standard in technical education. Vision To offer quality education in Electronics and Communication Engineering that addresses industry and societal challenges through a need-based curriculum, robust industry-institute interaction, and a student-centric teaching-learning process. We aim to produce diploma graduates who embody innovative and ethical standards.

Mission To develop high-quality, sustainable engineers through research, innovation, and teamwork, ensuring lasting technological advancements in Electronics and Communication Engineering. The department is committed to creating skilled technical professionals who can meet the dynamic demands of the industry and societal needs. Pillay Polytechnic College is a self-financing institution located in Nagapattinam District, established through the vision and dynamism of Chevalier Dr. G.S. Pillay. Since its founding in 2011, the college has been a beacon of educational excellence.

Managed by the G.S. Pillay & Sons Charitable and Educational Trust, the college offers five programs: Civil Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical and Electronics Engineering (EEE), Electronics and Communication Engineering (ECE), and Computer Science Engineering (CSE). It is affiliated with AICTE and the Directorate of Technical Education.

The college has been sanctioned by the National Service Scheme (NSS) Organization in 2014 to inaugurate an NSS unit, promoting social service activities and fostering a spirit of helping among students. As an associate member of TNSCST, Government of Tamil Nadu, the college facilitates industry-institute interactions and, in 2019, served as the district host for the Capacity Building for Technical Engineers Program.

Additionally, the college has established an Entrepreneurship Development Cell and organized an Entrepreneurship Development Program for final-year students under the PM-YUVA Scheme by the Government of India. E.G.S. Pillay Polytechnic College consistently excels in academic performance, achieving top rankings at both district and state levels.
